description:
The world has never seen an Omegaverse story quite like this. Beta top X Beta bottom?! The Omegaverse setting was simply an excuse!

Da-hoon and Sung-joon entered into an arranged marriage for business reasons. Despite their arranged marriage, they were as reputable as any other Alpha-Omega couple thanks to their outstanding personalities.

But they each had a secret... “He must never find out that I’m a Beta!”

---
